faq.everything-you-need-to: Everything you need to know about SettelyUK and how we handle your settlement journey.
faq.settelyuk-is-built-for: SettelyUK is built for refugees, migrants and newcomers settling in the UK who need clear, trustworthy guidance on everyday life.
faq.the-app-offers-guidance: The app offers guidance in English and Arabic, with more native languages being added over time.
faq.is-settelyuk-an-official: Is SettelyUK an official UK Government application?
faq.no-settelyuk-is-an: No. SettelyUK is an independent support platform and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the UK Government.
faq.can-i-use-the: Can I use the app without sharing my real-time location?
faq.yes-you-can-choose: Yes. You can choose your area manually, so you never have to share your real-time location to get local guidance.
faq.what-settlement-guides-are: What settlement guides are included in the free version?
faq.all-core-settlement-guides: All core settlement guides — including NHS, banking and tenancy — are free for everyone.
faq.is-settelyuk-completely-free: Is SettelyUK completely free to use?
faq.the-core-app-is: The core app is free for individuals. Optional Pro and Family plans unlock extra tools for those who want them.
